scope: Exploratory isolated grain-pair stiffness and timestep study on Metal; stiffness kn*=kappa*p_ref/d_ref fixed during each run, kt/kn=0.5, unchanged physical density. Nominal target force p_ref*d_ref^2 is a declared single-contact load scale, not bulk pressure or a specimen. Convex half-space FP64 reference supplies static force/torque and root load poses; no CPU dynamics. Fixed quadrature per fixture, with two finer static challenges. Study-only preflight bypass records production rejection. 15% diagnostic overlap guard allows soft-contact observations; the original 1% production comparison remains separately reported. No calibration or material admission. All roots, refinement failures, GPU rejections and timestep errors retained; no gate retuning.
